name: linear_get_viewer
description: Get the authenticated user's Linear profile and organization.

name: linear_list_teams
description: List all teams in the Linear organization with member counts.

name: linear_get_team
description: Get details for a specific Linear team by ID.

name: linear_get_team_by_key
description: Get a Linear team by its short key (e.g. 'ENG', 'WEB', 'OPS').

name: linear_list_issues
description: List Linear issues with optional filters for team, assignee, state type, priority, or label.

state_type.description: triage, backlog, unstarted, started, completed, or cancelled

name: linear_get_issue
description: Get a specific Linear issue by its UUID or identifier (e.g. ENG-42).

name: linear_search_issues
description: Full-text search across Linear issues by title and description.

name: linear_create_issue
description: Create a new Linear issue with optional assignment, priority, labels, project, and cycle.

name: linear_update_issue
description: Update an existing Linear issue — title, description, state, assignee, priority, labels, or due date.

name: linear_delete_issue
description: Delete a Linear issue permanently.

name: linear_assign_issue
description: Assign or unassign a Linear issue to a user.

assignee_id.description: User ID to assign, or null to unassign

name: linear_move_issue_to_state
description: Move a Linear issue to a specific workflow state (e.g. In Progress, Done).

name: linear_set_issue_priority
description: Set the priority of a Linear issue (0=none, 1=urgent, 2=high, 3=medium, 4=low).

name: linear_add_label_to_issue
description: Add a label to a Linear issue without removing existing labels.

name: linear_archive_issue
description: Archive a Linear issue (hides it from the default view without deleting).

name: linear_my_issues
description: Get issues assigned to the authenticated user, filtered by state type.

name: linear_list_comments
description: List all comments on a Linear issue.

name: linear_create_comment
description: Add a comment to a Linear issue.

name: linear_update_comment
description: Edit an existing comment on a Linear issue.

name: linear_delete_comment
description: Delete a comment from a Linear issue.

name: linear_list_workflow_states
description: List all workflow states (e.g. Backlog, In Progress, Done) for a team or the whole organization.

name: linear_list_labels
description: List all issue labels, optionally filtered to a specific team.

name: linear_create_label
description: Create a new issue label for a team.

name: linear_list_projects
description: List Linear projects with state, progress, and target dates.

name: linear_get_project
description: Get details for a specific Linear project including progress and dates.

name: linear_create_project
description: Create a new Linear project linked to one or more teams.

name: linear_update_project
description: Update a Linear project's name, state, or dates.

name: linear_list_cycles
description: List sprint cycles for a team, with issue counts and progress.

name: linear_get_active_cycle
description: Get the currently active sprint cycle for a team with progress metrics.

name: linear_create_cycle
description: Create a new sprint cycle for a team.

name: linear_list_members
description: List all active members in the Linear organization.

name: linear_get_member
description: Get a Linear member by user ID or email address.

name: linear_list_roadmaps
description: List Linear roadmaps and their associated projects.

name: linear_my_work_today
description: SUPER TOOL: Get all issues assigned to you that are in-progress or unstarted — your daily work queue.

name: linear_sprint_status
description: SUPER TOOL: Full sprint status for a team — cycle progress, in-progress issues, unstarted issues, completions, and urgent blockers.

name: linear_create_issue_for_commit
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a Linear issue linked to a git commit — automatically adds the commit URL to the issue description.

name: linear_project_health
description: SUPER TOOL: Project health check — progress %, overdue issues, unassigned issues, and urgent open items.

name: linear_triage_queue
description: SUPER TOOL: Get all unresolved urgent/high-priority issues across all teams, sorted by priority — your triage queue.
